name: mindfulcn
description: Free, curated shadcn/ui themes built from Alex Cristache's mindful palettes. Preview in light and dark mode, then copy tweakcn-ready CSS.

themes.name: rustic forest
themes.description: Blending soft creams, warm accents and deep forest greens in a cozy, rustic, nature inspired palette.

themes.name: midnight cove
themes.description: Soft pastels, deep blue-greens in a sophisticated palette fit for coastal resorts, luxury spas, or organic skincare products.

themes.name: blush at dusk
themes.description: Brings together blush tones, aquatic vibes, and a deep twilight blue. Perfect for emotionally driven design, like beauty and personal care.

themes.name: anchored ember
themes.description: Contrasts warm, light tones with cool, grounding tones in a modern, vibrant and engaging palette.

themes.name: indigo atelier
themes.description: Pairs soft, warm tones evoking handcrafting with deep navy anchors for a grounded look with a human touch. Great for artisanal and boutique brands.

themes.name: electric tide
themes.description: Modern palette that blends soft off-white and warm neutrals with vibrant lime, cool ocean tones, and deep teals. A high-contrast aquatic-inspired selection.

themes.name: still meadow
themes.description: Built for brands that value calm, authenticity, and a slower pace. Well suited to wellness, nature, and mindful living.
